project: SIRENA-KBR v5.0 Test Coverage & Model Improvements

user_stories.title: Test RidgeExtendedForecaster
user_stories.description: Create unit tests for RidgeExtendedForecaster (ridge_extended.py). Test fit(), predict(), backtest() methods. Verify calendar features (is_jan, is_jul, quarter_sin).

user_stories.title: Test RidgeShockDummiesForecaster
user_stories.description: Create unit tests for RidgeShockDummiesForecaster. Test shock dummy variables (is_shock_dec2014, is_shock_jan2015, is_tariff_jul2017).
acceptance_criteria: Verify shock dummies are correctly created for 2014-2015

user_stories.title: Test RidgeMacroForecaster
user_stories.description: Create unit tests for RidgeMacroForecaster. Test macro features (ki_L6, usd_L2, brent_L5) with optimal lags from Granger tests.
acceptance_criteria: Verify feature importance includes macro variables

user_stories.title: Test ElasticNetForecaster
user_stories.description: Create unit tests for ElasticNetForecaster. Test L1+L2 regularization, automatic feature selection via CV.
acceptance_criteria: Verify alpha and l1_ratio are properly tuned

user_stories.title: Test HuberForecaster
user_stories.description: Create unit tests for HuberForecaster. Test robustness to outliers with Huber loss.
acceptance_criteria: Verify epsilon parameter effect on outlier handling

user_stories.title: Test NGBoostForecaster
user_stories.description: Create unit tests for NGBoostForecaster. Test probabilistic predictions (prediction, ci_lower, ci_upper, std).

user_stories.title: Test NGBoostShockForecaster
user_stories.description: Create unit tests for NGBoostShockForecaster. Test shock dummies integration with NGBoost.
acceptance_criteria: Verify shock periods are handled correctly

user_stories.title: Test EBMForecaster
user_stories.description: Create unit tests for EBMForecaster (Explainable Boosting Machine). Test feature interpretability.
acceptance_criteria: Verify feature contributions can be extracted

user_stories.title: Test BayesianRidgeForecaster
user_stories.description: Create unit tests for BayesianRidgeForecaster. Test automatic regularization, confidence intervals.
acceptance_criteria: Verify alpha/lambda are learned from data

user_stories.title: Test SubcomponentForecaster
user_stories.description: Create unit tests for SubcomponentForecaster. Test bottom-up aggregation of 45 subcomponents with optimal features.
acceptance_criteria: Verify weighted aggregation matches Rosstat formula

user_stories.title: Test SubcomponentMultiForecaster
user_stories.description: Create unit tests for SubcomponentMultiForecaster. Test multi-model approach (Ridge, Prophet, NGBoost per subcomponent).

user_stories.title: Test MicrocomponentForecaster
user_stories.description: Create unit tests for MicrocomponentForecaster. Test 497 individual models aggregation.

user_stories.title: Test HierarchicalMicroForecaster
user_stories.description: Create unit tests for HierarchicalMicroForecaster. Test 4-level hierarchy (micro→subcomp→comp→total).

user_stories.title: Test HorizonEnsembleForecaster
user_stories.description: Create unit tests for HorizonEnsembleForecaster. Test adaptive weights (Huber for h=1, Micro for h=12).

user_stories.title: Test RegimeDetector
user_stories.description: Create unit tests for RegimeDetector. Test regime classification (normal, shock, high_inflation).

user_stories.title: Test ScenarioRateModel
user_stories.description: Create unit tests for ScenarioRateModel. Test rate transmission calibration.

user_stories.title: Test KiTrajectoryForecaster
user_stories.description: Create unit tests for KiTrajectoryForecaster. Test Taylor rule implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Verify key rate forecasts are reasonable

user_stories.title: Test UnifiedSubcomponentForecaster
user_stories.description: Create unit tests for UnifiedSubcomponentForecaster. Test baseline + scenario integration.

user_stories.title: Integration test: Full backtest pipeline
user_stories.description: Create integration test that runs backtest_framework.py for all models on h=1, h=2, h=12.

user_stories.title: Integration test: Dashboard data flow
user_stories.description: Create integration test for dashboard.py data pipeline (load → model → plot).

user_stories.title: New model: MIDAS (Mixed Data Sampling)
user_stories.description: Implement MIDASForecaster using weekly prices to improve monthly forecasts. Use Almon polynomial distributed lags.

user_stories.title: New model: Temporal Fusion Transformer
user_stories.description: Implement TFTForecaster using pytorch-forecasting. Multi-horizon attention-based model.

user_stories.title: New model: Conformal Prediction wrapper
user_stories.description: Implement ConformalForecaster that wraps any base model with calibrated prediction intervals.

user_stories.title: Improve ExogProphetForecaster
user_stories.description: Add Brent oil prices as regressor. Tune changepoint_prior_scale for KBR data.

user_stories.title: Add model comparison report generator
user_stories.description: Create script that generates HTML report comparing all models across h=1, h=2, h=12 with charts.

user_stories.title: API endpoint: /models/{name}/explain
user_stories.description: Add REST API endpoint that returns feature importance and SHAP values for any model.

user_stories.title: Nowcasting: Weekly signal integration
user_stories.description: Improve weekly nowcasting signal by using more products (top 20 by weight).
acceptance_criteria: Weekly signal covers >= 30% of CPI basket

user_stories.title: Data validation: Monthly data checks
user_stories.description: Add data validation script that checks for missing values, outliers, format issues in input CSVs.

user_stories.title: Performance: Cache model predictions
user_stories.description: Add Redis/file caching for expensive model predictions (BVAR, Prophet, NGBoost).

user_stories.title: Documentation: Update CLAUDE.md
user_stories.description: Update CLAUDE.md with all new models, test commands, and backtest results from v5.0.
